title: Chafe

inlines.v: CHAFE, verb transitive 1. To excite heat or inflammation by friction, as to chafe the skin; also, to fret and wear by rubbing, as to chafe a cable. 2. To act violently upon, by rubbing; to fret against, as waves against a shore. The troubled Tyber chafing with his shores. 3. To be fretted and worn by rubbing; as, a cable chafes. CHAFE, noun 1. Heat, excited by friction. 2. Violent agitation of the mind or passions; heat; fret; passion.
